org_zh: 北卡羅來納大學威爾明頓分校
unit_en: Department of Biology and Marine Biology
expertise_en: Coral probiotics; stony coral tissue loss disease (SCTLD); coral pathogens and microbe-microbe antagonism
expertise_zh: 珊瑚益生菌；石珊瑚組織流失症（SCTLD）；珊瑚病原菌與微生物間拮抗機制
summary_en: After their literature review, the team held an online call with Dr. Ushijima and his team to validate their concept; his paper on a potential probiotic treatment for SCTLD was one of the project's first sources of inspiration. He advised against focusing on a single probiotic, since different coral species under different stresses need different probiotics, and told the team to pick a specific coral and stress type to target.
summary_zh: 團隊完成文獻回顧後，與 Ushijima 博士及其團隊進行線上會議，驗證專案構想；他關於石珊瑚組織流失症潛在益生菌療法的論文是本專案最早的靈感來源之一。他建議不要只鎖定單一益生菌，因為不同珊瑚物種在不同壓力下需要不同的益生菌，並建議團隊選定特定的珊瑚與壓力類型作為目標。
impact_en: The design shifted from engineering the probiotics themselves to produce biofilm to a general biofilm-producing carrier bacterium (SAR11) that acts as a temporary, biodegradable glue able to attach any mix of probiotics.
impact_zh: 設計從「改造益生菌本身產生生物膜」轉為使用通用的生物膜生產菌（SAR11）作為暫時性、可生物分解的黏著劑，可附著任何益生菌組合。

photos.caption_en: Online call with Dr. Blake Ushijima and his team
photos.caption_zh: 與 Blake Ushijima 博士及其團隊的線上會議

city_zh: 北卡羅來納州威爾明頓

unit_en: Department of Biochemical Science and Technology – Synthetic Biology and Biofabrication Laboratory (Lab 106)
unit_zh: 生化科技學系 合成生物與生物製造實驗室（106 室）
expertise_en: Synthetic biology; metabolic engineering; biofabrication and biomaterials; quorum-sensing switches
expertise_zh: 合成生物學；代謝工程；生物製造與生物材料；群體感應開關
summary_en: The team carried out all its wet-lab work in Dr. Wu's BSL-1 laboratory (Lab 106) at NTU, and consulted him on the cloning cycle and construct design strategy. After repeated failures with PCR and overlap PCR they held a troubleshooting session, where he told them to check the manufacturer's protocols for Q5 polymerase and Gibson Assembly and to redesign all primers. The attribution form also credits him with approving their lab activity and inspiring their quorum-sensing mechanism.
summary_zh: 團隊所有濕實驗皆在吳亘承老師位於臺大的生物安全第一等級實驗室（106 室）進行，並向他請教選殖流程與構築體設計策略。在 PCR 與 overlap PCR 多次失敗後，團隊與他進行除錯討論，他建議依照原廠手冊（而非網路上流傳的通用流程）驗證 Q5 聚合酶與 Gibson Assembly 的操作，並重新設計所有引子。貢獻表亦記載他提供實驗室、核准實驗活動，並啟發了團隊的群體感應機制。
impact_en: The team redesigned and reordered its primers, after which the primary construct was successfully transformed into the bacteria.
impact_zh: 團隊重新設計並訂購引子，之後主要構築體成功轉形進入菌株。

title_en: Research Fellow and Deputy Director, Biodiversity Research Center
title_zh: 研究員兼生物多樣性研究中心副主任
unit_en: Biodiversity Research Center – Marine Microbial Ecology Lab
unit_zh: 生物多樣性研究中心 海洋微生物生態實驗室
expertise_en: Marine microbial ecology; coral reef microbes; microbial genomics and metagenomics; computational microbiology
expertise_zh: 海洋微生物生態；珊瑚礁微生物；微生物基因體與總體基因體學；計算微生物學
summary_en: The team met Dr. Tang in person to assess the feasibility of their probiotic delivery method. He pointed out that corals do not absorb external substances through their exoskeletons and that they secrete protective mucus, endorsed using AI-driven robots to deliver the product to coral colonies, and raised ethical concerns about releasing GMOs into the ocean. The team also consulted him on where to begin researching GMO regulations, and he approved their quorum-sensing kill-switch biosafety design.
summary_zh: 團隊與湯森林老師實體會面，評估益生菌遞送方式的可行性。他指出珊瑚不會透過外骨骼吸收外部物質，且會分泌保護性黏液；他支持以 AI 驅動的機器人將產品精準遞送至珊瑚群落，並提出在海洋中釋放基因改造生物的倫理疑慮。團隊也向他請教 GMO 法規研究的切入點，他並認可團隊以群體感應為基礎的自殺開關生物安全設計。
impact_en: The team switched its chassis from Pseudoalteromonas luteoviolacea to SAR11, a bacterium corals consume as food, so corals would ingest the bacteria together with the probiotics. His ethics concerns led directly to the Coral Public Awareness Survey, which included questions on public comfort with GMOs.
impact_zh: 團隊將底盤菌從 Pseudoalteromonas luteoviolacea 改為珊瑚會攝食的 SAR11，讓珊瑚把工程菌連同益生菌一併吃下。他提出的倫理疑慮直接促成「珊瑚公眾認知問卷」，其中納入民眾對 GMO 接受度的題目。

photos.caption_en: In-person meeting with Dr. Sen-Lin Tang about the probiotic delivery method
photos.caption_zh: 與湯森林老師實體討論益生菌遞送方式

title_zh: 微生物生態學家／研究科學家
expertise_en: Microbial ecology; coral diets and probiotics for reef restoration in aquaculture; aquaculture microbiology and biocontrol
expertise_zh: 微生物生態學；用於珊瑚礁復育的珊瑚飼料與益生菌養殖；水產養殖微生物學與生物防治
summary_en: In a first online meeting Dr. Høj reviewed the engineered-SAR11 approach, endorsed it, stressed scalability of the robotic delivery system, and proposed metagenomic monitoring of microbiome effects and of coral growth and survival. In a second meeting on the improved design she suggested delivering probiotics as solid coral-feed pellets or a spray (leaning toward the spray for large-scale use), testing the optimal dose, timing applications around stressors such as heat waves, and testing interactions between probiotics and SAR11. For entrepreneurship she also supported the product and its market potential.
summary_zh: 在第一次線上會議中，Høj 博士審視並肯定團隊的工程 SAR11 方案，強調機器人遞送系統須具可擴展性，並建議以總體基因體分析監測對珊瑚微生物組的影響，以及追蹤珊瑚的生長與存活。第二次會議評估改良設計時，她建議以固態珊瑚飼料顆粒或噴霧遞送益生菌（因大規模應用潛力而較傾向噴霧），並建議測試最適施用量、依熱浪等環境壓力安排施用時程，以及評估不同益生菌與 SAR11 之間的交互作用。在創業面向上，她也支持此產品的開發與市場潛力。
impact_en: Her input fed into the liquid probiotic spray design, application scheduling for the robot, and planned co-culture tests of probiotics with SAR11; she was cited as a research-market representative in customer discovery and as an expert endorsing the biosafety design.
impact_zh: 她的建議影響了液態益生菌噴霧設計、機器人施用時程規劃，以及益生菌與 SAR11 共培養測試的規劃；她也在客戶探索中被列為研究端市場代表，並作為認可生物安全設計的專家之一。

photos.caption_en: Online meeting with Dr. Lone Høj on SAR11 and corals
photos.caption_zh: 與 Lone Høj 博士線上討論 SAR11 與珊瑚

unit_en: Marine and Aquaculture Sciences (also affiliated with the Australian Institute of Marine Science)
unit_zh: 海洋與水產養殖科學（亦任職於澳洲海洋科學研究所）
expertise_en: Molecular microbial ecology; coral microbiology, pathogens and disease; Beneficial Microorganisms for Corals (BMC)
expertise_zh: 分子微生物生態學；珊瑚微生物、病原與疾病；珊瑚有益微生物（BMC）
summary_en: The team held an online meeting with Prof. Bourne, whose review introducing 'Beneficial Microorganisms for Corals' was one of the project's main inspirations, to check feasibility. He asked how coral mucus regeneration would affect the application mechanism, how the probiotic strain choice would affect feasibility, and pushed the team to choose a specific target coral species. He also approved the self-destructive biosafety mechanism and supported the product from a research-market perspective.
summary_zh: 團隊與 Bourne 教授進行線上會議評估可行性；他提出「珊瑚有益微生物」概念的回顧論文是本專案最重要的靈感來源之一。他提出珊瑚黏液再生是否會影響施用機制、益生菌株選擇對可行性的影響等問題，並要求團隊選定特定目標珊瑚物種。他也認可團隊的自殺型生物安全機制，並從研究市場角度支持此產品。
impact_en: The team chose reef-building corals as its target, confirmed that their mucus turnover leaves enough time for the probiotics and biofilm to integrate into the holobiont, and moved to a more feasible application as a solid coral feed.
impact_zh: 團隊選定造礁珊瑚為目標，確認其黏液更新速率足以讓益生菌與生物膜整合進珊瑚共生體，並改採較可行的固態珊瑚飼料施用形式。

photos.caption_en: Online meeting with Prof. David Bourne
photos.caption_zh: 與 David Bourne 教授的線上會議

photos.caption_zh: 與 David Bourne 教授的線上會議

org_en: National Museum of Marine Science and Technology
expertise_en: Coral conservation and coral diseases; public marine education through BioArt
expertise_zh: 珊瑚保育與珊瑚疾病；以生物藝術（BioArt）進行海洋科普教育
summary_en: Team members visited NMMST in Keelung and met Dr. Yu-Hung Tsai, who explained current approaches to coral diseases, suggested how to optimise the delivery mechanism, and showed BioArt teaching materials such as crocheted coral hats, coral structures and a crocheted marine ecosystem. The team took part in an environment-themed BioArt exhibition, presented its planned summer-camp materials and asked for advice on effective teaching methods.
summary_zh: 團隊成員前往基隆的國立海洋科技博物館拜訪蔡博士。他說明目前對抗珊瑚疾病的做法、建議如何優化遞送機制，並展示鉤織珊瑚帽、珊瑚結構與鉤織海洋生態環境等生物藝術教材。團隊也參與了環境主題的生物藝術展，並展示為夏令營準備的教材，請教有效的教學方法。
impact_en: The visit led to the liquid probiotic spray implementation, and inspired the team to add BioArt to its education plan and the iGEM Syn-Bio Summer Camp.
impact_zh: 此次參訪促成液態益生菌噴霧的實施方式，並啟發團隊將生物藝術納入教育計畫與 iGEM 合成生物夏令營。

photos.caption_zh: 實地參訪國立海洋科技博物館

photos.caption_zh: 團隊成員於海科館

org_en: Ocean Conservation Administration, Ocean Affairs Council
org_zh: 海洋委員會海洋保育署
expertise_en: Marine conservation policy; marine protected areas; coral regulation; marine conservation education
expertise_zh: 海洋保育政策；海洋保護區；珊瑚相關法規；海洋保育教育
summary_en: The team interviewed the OCA about the ethical and political challenges of implementing the project in Taiwan. The OCA explained the complex legal issues around many coral species, said more data on the product's benefits would be needed for any approval, stressed involving enthusiasts, professionals and the public in conservation, and noted that about 70% of conservation work in Taiwan is outsourced. It also said there are currently no regulations against releasing or using GMO-containing products in the ocean.
summary_zh: 團隊訪談海洋保育署，了解在臺灣落實專案時的倫理與政策挑戰。海保署說明許多珊瑚物種涉及複雜的法律問題，未來若要取得核准需要更多證明產品效益的數據；並強調應讓愛好者、專業人士與一般民眾共同參與保育，也指出臺灣約七成保育工作為委外執行。海保署亦表示目前沒有法規禁止在海洋中釋放或使用含基因改造生物的產品。
impact_en: The interview shaped the team's ethics framework and, with Dr. Tang's input, the design of the Coral Public Awareness Survey. The entrepreneurship page states that, given some experimental success, the OCA drafted a potential contract proposal for Taiwan's reef areas, positioning Cure-All Reef as a possible government-contracted service.
impact_zh: 此次訪談形塑了團隊的倫理框架，並與湯森林老師的建議共同促成珊瑚公眾認知問卷的設計。創業頁面指出，若實驗取得初步成果，海保署已草擬針對臺灣珊瑚礁區的潛在合作提案，顯示本專案具成為政府委託服務的潛力。

org_en: The Marine Ecology Art Research Institute
expertise_en: Integrating marine biology and art; ecological art and BioArt education
expertise_zh: 結合海洋生物學與藝術；生態藝術與生物藝術教育
summary_en: Because survey respondents preferred learning through BioArt, the team held an online meeting with the institute, whose members share a passion for marine biology and art. They discussed integrating science and art in teaching about corals, current BioArt trends such as ocean-waste recycling, and advice for high schoolers interested in ecological art (join art clubs, set clear goals, use scientific literature). The institute said it welcomes collaborations that bring art into ecological teaching.
summary_zh: 由於問卷顯示受訪者偏好透過生物藝術學習，團隊與該研究所進行線上會議；其成員同時熱愛海洋生物學與藝術。雙方討論如何在珊瑚教育中融合科學與藝術、以海洋廢棄物回收為主的生物藝術趨勢，以及給對生態藝術有興趣之高中生的建議（加入藝術社團、設定明確目標、善用科學文獻）。該研究所表示歡迎將藝術融入生態教學的合作。
impact_en: The team learned how to present BioArt in a more engaging way and used it in the BioArt lesson of the iGEM Syn-Bio Summer Camp.
impact_zh: 團隊學到如何更生動地呈現生物藝術，並運用於 iGEM 合成生物夏令營的生物藝術課程。

photos.caption_en: Online meeting with the Marine Ecology Art Research Institute
photos.caption_zh: 與海洋生態藝術研究所的線上會議

expertise_en: Commercial coral farming and coral supply; shallow-water coral harvesting regulations
expertise_zh: 商業珊瑚養殖與供應；淺海珊瑚採集法規
summary_en: The team visited Panchi Coral Company and learned that protecting shallow-water corals requires fixed harvesting seasons, detailed records and strict inspections. They presented the product concept to get feedback from a large coral company; CEO Yan Qingzhen said the coral spray would be very useful for maintaining its coral farms and a consistent coral supply, and saw strong growth potential for the product across the coral market.
summary_zh: 團隊參訪 Panchi 珊瑚公司，了解到保護淺海珊瑚須遵守特定採集季節、詳細紀錄與嚴格檢查。團隊向這家大型珊瑚公司介紹產品概念以取得回饋；執行長 Yan Qingzhen 表示珊瑚噴霧對維護其珊瑚養殖場與穩定供貨很有幫助，並認為產品在整個珊瑚市場都有很大的成長潛力。
impact_en: Panchi served as the coral-farm customer representative in customer discovery for the Reef Resilience Service, helping the team align its business plan with the needs of large coral companies.
impact_zh: Panchi 在「珊瑚韌性服務」的客戶探索中作為珊瑚養殖業者代表，協助團隊讓商業計畫更貼近大型珊瑚業者的需求。

title_en: Chief Director of Coral Reef Check and Coral Restoration
title_zh: 珊瑚礁體檢與珊瑚復育負責人
expertise_en: Coral reef monitoring (Reef Check) and coral restoration diving in Taiwan; environmental media
expertise_zh: 臺灣珊瑚礁體檢（Reef Check）與珊瑚復育潛水；環境媒體
summary_en: In an online meeting with TEIA's Hsuan-Chou Chen (and marine biologist Jude Lin), both experienced coral-restoration divers, the team learned about the state of Taiwan's corals and how weak public awareness leads to little government action and funding. On GMO regulation their view matched the OCA's: there are no current restrictions on GMOs in products such as a coral spray. They stressed logistics instead: surveying affected areas, planning dive distribution, and the roughly half-hour limit per oxygen tank.
summary_zh: 團隊與台灣環境資訊協會的陳玄州先生（及海洋生物專家 Jude Lin）進行線上會議，兩人都是經驗豐富的珊瑚復育潛水員。團隊了解臺灣珊瑚現況，以及公眾認知不足導致政府行動與經費缺乏的困境。關於 GMO 法規，他們的看法與海保署一致：目前沒有限制珊瑚噴霧這類產品使用 GMO 的規定；他們更強調實際施用的後勤問題，包括評估受影響區域、規劃潛水分工，以及每支氣瓶約半小時的作業時間限制。
impact_en: Their concerns shaped the underwater coral spray's efficiency targets and the hardware designed to reduce reliance on diver labour, and reinforced the motivation for the education program.
impact_zh: 他們的意見影響了水下珊瑚噴霧的效率設計與降低潛水人力依賴的硬體設計，也強化了團隊推動教育活動的動機。

photos.caption_en: Online meeting with Hsuan-Chou Chen of TEIA
photos.caption_zh: 與台灣環境資訊協會陳玄州先生的線上會議

title_zh: 海洋生物專家；CoralWatch 計畫成員
expertise_en: Marine biology; coral health monitoring; coral restoration diving
expertise_zh: 海洋生物學；珊瑚健康監測；珊瑚復育潛水
summary_en: Jude Lin, a marine biology expert with the CoralWatch project and an experienced coral-restoration diver, joined the team's online meeting arranged through TEIA's Hsuan-Chou Chen. Together they described the state of Taiwan's corals, the public's lack of awareness, and the practical logistics of applying a product underwater.
summary_zh: Jude Lin 是 CoralWatch 計畫的海洋生物專家，也是經驗豐富的珊瑚復育潛水員，透過台灣環境資訊協會陳玄州先生的安排參與團隊的線上會議，與陳先生一同說明臺灣珊瑚現況、民眾認知不足的問題，以及在水下施用產品的實際後勤考量。
impact_en: Contributed to the logistics considerations (dive time per oxygen tank, area assessment) behind the spray and hardware design.
impact_zh: 協助團隊掌握噴霧與硬體設計所需的後勤考量（每支氣瓶的潛水時間、受影響區域評估）。

photos.caption_en: Online meeting with Jude Lin
photos.caption_zh: 與 Jude Lin 的線上會議

expertise_en: Climate action; ESG; coral restoration partnerships (with NMMST in Keelung); clean technology promotion
expertise_zh: 氣候行動；ESG；珊瑚復育合作（與基隆海科館）；潔淨技術推廣
summary_en: The team reached out to Delta Electronics Foundation CEO Wim Chang, since Delta already works on coral restoration and has propagated and transplanted nearly a thousand corals with the ocean museum in Keelung. They discussed the project concept and its future, opening the door to future collaboration. Delta expressed interest in collaborating on the Reef Resilience Service.
summary_zh: 由於台達已投入珊瑚復育，並與基隆的海洋博物館合作繁殖、移植近千株珊瑚，團隊聯繫台達電子文教基金會執行長張楊乾。雙方討論專案概念與未來發展，為日後合作開啟大門；台達表示有興趣就「珊瑚韌性服務」進行合作。
impact_en: Delta became the large-corporation customer representative in customer discovery and a potential partner and customer for the Reef Resilience Service's blue-carbon credit model.
impact_zh: 台達成為客戶探索中的大型企業代表，也是「珊瑚韌性服務」藍碳權模式的潛在合作夥伴與客戶。

unit_en: Institute of Molecular Medicine, College of Medicine
unit_zh: 醫學院 分子醫學研究所
expertise_en: Bacterial genetics; E. coli genome engineering
expertise_zh: 細菌遺傳學；大腸桿菌基因體工程
summary_en: Dr. Hashimoto provided the materials for the planned csg-operon knockout by homologous recombination: E. coli MG1655 carrying the pKD46 helper plasmid and a plasmid encoding the FLP recombinase to remove the kanamycin-resistance gene.
summary_zh: 橋本昌征博士提供團隊以同源重組剔除 csg 操縱組所需的材料：帶有 pKD46 輔助質體的大腸桿菌 MG1655，以及用於移除康黴素抗性基因、表現 FLP 重組酶的質體。
impact_en: Enabled the knockout design; the team did not complete the knockout because of cloning delays.
impact_zh: 使剔除實驗設計得以進行，但因選殖進度延誤，團隊最終未完成剔除。

unit_en: Dr. Hsuan-Chen Wu's lab (Lab 106), Department of Biochemical Science and Technology
unit_zh: 生化科技學系 吳亘承老師實驗室（106 室）
expertise_en: Molecular cloning; primer design; lab supervision
expertise_zh: 分子選殖；引子設計；實驗室指導
summary_en: Listed on the iGEM attribution form as an academic external advisor who designed and checked the team's primers, helped troubleshoot during lab training, assisted with experiments, helped plan lab work and supervised lab activities for safety.
summary_zh: iGEM 貢獻表將其列為學術界外部顧問：協助設計並檢查引子、在實驗訓練中協助除錯、協助進行實驗與規劃實驗，並監督實驗室安全。

unit_en: Dr. Hsuan-Chen Wu's lab (Lab 106), Department of Biochemical Science and Technology
unit_zh: 生化科技學系 吳亘承老師實驗室（106 室）
expertise_en: Engineering-cycle troubleshooting; lab supervision and safety
expertise_zh: 工程循環除錯；實驗室指導與安全
summary_en: Listed on the iGEM attribution form as an academic external advisor who helped troubleshoot the engineering cycle, gave insight on the project, led the team in the lab and supervised experiments to make sure safety measures were met.
summary_zh: iGEM 貢獻表將其列為學術界外部顧問：協助工程循環除錯、提供專案建議、在實驗室帶領團隊，並監督實驗以確保符合安全規範。

expertise_en: Web development; front-end animation and debugging
expertise_zh: 網頁開發；前端動畫與除錯
summary_en: Listed on the iGEM attribution form as an external advisor from industry who guided the software team on fine-tuning the home-page parallax animation and the member-page slider, helped with debugging, and mediated communication between the software team and other members.
summary_zh: iGEM 貢獻表將其列為業界外部顧問：指導軟體組調整首頁視差動畫與成員頁滑動效果、協助除錯，並協調軟體組與其他成員之間的溝通。

expertise_en: DNA synthesis (gene fragments and primers)
expertise_zh: DNA 合成（基因片段與引子）
summary_en: IDT synthesised the team's gene fragments and primers, including the MetJ construct, which was synthesised in five fragments, and the biosafety construct.
summary_zh: IDT 為團隊合成基因片段與引子，包括分成五段合成的 MetJ 構築體與生物安全構築體。

expertise_en: Youth advocacy for the UN Sustainable Development Goals
expertise_zh: 青年推動聯合國永續發展目標
summary_en: The team collaborated with SDA17, a group of high school students championing the UN SDGs, and published a series of articles on its website about coral threats, the economic and social effects of coral degradation, co-culture interactions, reef-monitoring software and the benefits of coral probiotics. SDA17 also took part in the team's youth video series.
summary_zh: 團隊與推動聯合國永續發展目標的高中生團體 SDA17 合作，在其網站發表一系列文章，主題包括珊瑚面臨的威脅、珊瑚退化對經濟與社會的影響、共培養交互作用、珊瑚礁監測軟體以及珊瑚益生菌的好處。SDA17 也參與了團隊的青年影片系列。
impact_en: Gave the team a platform to reach a broader online audience with coral-conservation content.
impact_zh: 為團隊提供平台，將珊瑚保育內容推廣給更廣泛的線上讀者。

expertise_en: Student-run online publication
expertise_zh: 學生經營的線上刊物
summary_en: The team wrote and published the article 'Cure-All Reefs: A Cure to The Distressing Decline of Coral Reefs' on Student Gaze, a platform popular with high school students from various international schools. The article covered coral decline, the biofilm-based probiotic delivery idea and the quorum-sensing biosafety mechanism.
summary_zh: 團隊在 Student Gaze 撰寫並發表〈Cure-All Reefs: A Cure to The Distressing Decline of Coral Reefs〉一文。該平台深受多所國際學校高中生歡迎，文章介紹珊瑚衰退問題、以生物膜遞送益生菌的構想，以及群體感應生物安全機制。
impact_en: Extended the team's reach to a youth audience.
impact_zh: 將團隊的影響力延伸至青少年讀者。

expertise_en: Youth-founded environmental education non-profit
expertise_zh: 青年創立的環境教育非營利組織
summary_en: Green4Tomorrow took part in the team's beach cleanup and the youth video series, and co-published an Instagram post, 'All About Coral Bleaching'.
summary_zh: Green4Tomorrow 參與團隊的淨灘活動與青年影片系列，並共同發布 Instagram 貼文〈All About Coral Bleaching〉。

photos.caption_zh: Green4Tomorrow × GEMS_Taiwan 合作貼文〈All About Coral Bleaching〉

expertise_en: Youth climate activism
expertise_zh: 青年氣候行動
summary_en: Fridays For Future Taiwan took part in the team's beach cleanup and youth video series, and created a collaborative post introducing the team's mission and solution.
summary_zh: Fridays For Future Taiwan 參與團隊的淨灘活動與青年影片系列，並製作合作貼文介紹團隊的使命與解決方案。

expertise_en: Youth environmental group
expertise_zh: 青年環境團體
summary_en: MWCC, a non-profit youth group, took part in the team's beach cleanup and youth video series and published a collaborative post introducing the team.
summary_zh: 非營利青年團體 MWCC 參與團隊的淨灘活動與青年影片系列，並發布介紹團隊的合作貼文。

expertise_en: iGEM 2023 high-school team (orchid conservation project)
expertise_zh: iGEM 2023 高中組隊伍（蘭花保育專案）
summary_en: The WIST iGEM team joined GEMS Taiwan's Shalun Beach cleanup and the youth video series documenting Taiwanese teenagers' environmental efforts.
summary_zh: WIST iGEM 隊參與 GEMS Taiwan 在沙崙海灘舉辦的淨灘活動，以及記錄臺灣青少年環境行動的青年影片系列。

expertise_en: National news and business media
expertise_zh: 全國性新聞與商業媒體
summary_en: Listed on the iGEM attribution form as a collaborator: a platform for spreading coral-conservation messages to the public and a potential future sponsor. The wiki gives no further details.
summary_zh: iGEM 貢獻表將其列為合作單位：作為向大眾宣導珊瑚保育的平台，也是潛在的未來贊助者。Wiki 未提供更多細節。

expertise_en: Local and international volunteers
expertise_zh: 在地與國際志工
summary_en: The team hosted a beach cleanup at Shalun Beach with more than 85 volunteers, friends and team members from across Taiwan, collecting a significant amount of garbage and debris. Monica, a visitor from Spain, saw the promotion and joined with her own equipment.
summary_zh: 團隊在沙崙海灘舉辦淨灘活動，來自全臺的 85 位以上志工、朋友與隊員參與，清出大量垃圾與廢棄物。一位來自西班牙、正在臺灣度假的 Monica 看到活動宣傳，自備工具加入。
impact_en: Showed that the team's outreach could reach people beyond the local community, and led it to call for a global approach to marine conservation.
impact_zh: 顯示團隊的推廣能觸及在地社群以外的人，也促使團隊呼籲以全球視野推動海洋保育。

org_en: iGEM Syn-Bio Summer Camp participants (GEMS Academy)
expertise_en: Students interested in synthetic biology and future iGEM participation
expertise_zh: 對合成生物學與未來參加 iGEM 有興趣的學生
summary_en: The team ran a Synthetic Biology Summer Camp for students interested in synthetic biology and future iGEM teams. It included a BioArt lesson (essence, goals and ethics of BioArt, with iGEM BioArt examples and the iGEM virtual gallery), topic presentations where students chose iGEM tracks and brainstormed projects, and a Model United Nations session debating GMO biosafety and national regulations. Teaching methods were prepared with advice from GEMS Academy educators and NMMST.
summary_zh: 團隊為對合成生物學與未來參加 iGEM 有興趣的學生舉辦合成生物夏令營，內容包括生物藝術課程（介紹生物藝術的本質、目標與倫理，並展示 iGEM 隊伍的生物藝術案例與 iGEM 線上藝廊）、讓學生選擇 iGEM 賽道並發想專案的主題發表，以及討論 GMO 生物安全與各國法規的模擬聯合國活動。教學方法參考了 GEMS Academy 教師與海科館的建議。
impact_en: Put the survey finding (38.6% of 303 respondents preferred BioArt) into practice and trained potential future iGEMers.
impact_zh: 實踐問卷結果（303 位受訪者中 38.6% 偏好生物藝術），並培育未來可能參與 iGEM 的學生。
